1.text: “I Samariya hazagerekwaho igihano cyaho, kuko hagomeye Imana yaho: bazicishwa inkota; abana babo bato bazavungagurwa, kandi abagore babo batwite bazabafomoza.”

2.text: Isirayeli we, garukira Uwiteka Imana yawe, kuko wagushijwe n'igicumuro cyawe.

3.text: Mujyane amagambo mugarukire Uwiteka mumubwire muti “Udukureho gukiranirwa kose, utwakirane ineza maze tuzagutambire ishimwe ry'iminwa yacu.

4.text: Abashuri ntibazadukiza, ntituzagendera ku mafarashi kandi ntabwo tuzongera kubwira ubukorikori bwakozwe n'amaboko yacu tuti ‘Muri imana zacu’, kuko impfubyi ari wowe zibonaho kugirirwa imbabazi.

5.text: “Nzakiza gusubira inyuma kwabo, nzabakunda urukundo rutagabanije, kuko uburakari nabumukuyeho.

6.text: Nzamerera Isirayeli nk'ikime; azarabya nk'uburabyo, azashora imizi nk'i Lebanoni.

7.text: Amashami ye azagaba, kandi ubwiza bwe buzasa n'ubw'igiti cy'umwelayo, n'impumuro ye nk'i Lebanoni.

8.text: Ababa mu gicucu cye bazagaruka, bazashibuka nk'ingano batohe nk'umuzabibu, impumuro yabo izaba imeze nka vino y'i Lebanoni.

9.text: Efurayimu azavuga ati ‘Ndacyahuriye he n'ibigirwamana kandi?’ Narayumviye kandi nzayitaho, meze nk'umuberoshi utoshye, imbuto zawe ni jye ziturukaho.”

10.text: Uzi ubwenge wese ni we uzitegereza ibyo, uUwitonda wese ni we uzabimenya, kuko inzira z'Uwiteka zitunganye, kandi abakiranutsi bazazigenderamo, ariko abacumura bazazigwamo.
